reviews.title: Nice Stuff...
reviews.comment:
I got a new NZXT custom build and the case has extra room for more fans.  Did it NEED it?  Not really, but why run and intake and exhaust fan at 80% power (which you can hear) when you can run 3 Intakes and 2 Exhaust fans at 40% power (which is silent) and get more air moving through the case?
Bright White (matched my case), Installs like any other PWM fan.
Are there better fans?  Maybe, but if you just want affordable and quiet airflow?  These will do that and not break the bank.
reviews.author: That One Purchaser

reviews.author: Andy

reviews.title: A nice upgrade
reviews.comment: My Be Quiet DX500 came with the previous generation fans, and I wanted to add one more so this seemed like the way to go. I'm doubting if I needed the high-speed version as it did seem fairly loud on the default fan port settings. The case came with 3x Pure Wing 2's with 3 pins, and this looks very similar but has extra blades and a 4 pin connector. I had two front and one back/exhaust setup and this new one went in the top of the case. However, I'm thinking I need to swap this high-speed one to the rear/exhaust position. Once I got the fan profile setup to include this new fan, the sound profile does seem better. All of the fans seem to run a little slower rpm with the added airflow this new fan brought. Overall, I'm very happy, though I do wish this included the foam corner inserts. As the fourth case fan in this build, it is a good addition but maybe a bit too much.
reviews.author: Scott & Denise
